turns.text: consent fetch returns ABDM-1040 Invalid HIU ID. our facility is registered as both HIP and HIU if that matters

must_contain: ABDM-1040 is a registration problem, so retrying does not change it.
Confirm the entity is registered in the HIU role and that X-HIU-ID carries the HIU id, not the HIP id.
Keep the HIP and HIU ids in separate configuration values so they cannot be swapped.
notes: Entities holding both roles send the wrong id in X-HIU-ID, and the fetch endpoint requires that header.
